topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Slept on a story last night. Kid, college age, they say he's claiming as his work what isn’t. Now, I've seen enough cons to know that the game isn’t always as clear as the_marks_ make it out to be. I'm setting up to meet with him, see what shakes loose. Maybe he's got a tailspin of a tale, or maybe he's just another player in a town full of players. Gonna stick to the shadows, keep my eyes open. When the money's on the line, everyone's a suspect. This town, it’s a labyrinth, and I’ve got to navigate it without getting wet. I've got a feeling this could go places.
